description.body:
The United States Army Joint Munitions Command is conducting a market survey of industry to identify actual/potential sources that exhibit the capability to test and repackage Lead Azide, a commonly used military explosive.

The purpose of this sources sought is to identify companies capable of screening lead azide for compliance with serviceability requirements. The serviceability requirements are defined in the Quick Guide to Optical Microscopy of Lead Azide (attached to this announcement); analysis consists of optical microscopy of three samples from each bag and a pH reading. Lead azide is a primary class 1.1D explosive. The lead azide is packaged in 1525 lb bags which are packaged in metal drums containing 50% water and 50% ethanol. Total explosive weight of each drum is between 100-150 lbs. Successful offerors must demonstrate the capability to receive, store (up to 4 months), analyze and ship up to three drums of lead azide simultaneously. Furthermore, the offerors must have the capability to repackage unserviceable lead azide into 1 (one) lb bags and segregate into new drums. Both the bags as well as the drums will require tagging to enable quick identification of contents. Offerors are to document experience in handling class 1.1 materials and provide copies of ATF and DOJ licenses/certificates to transport, ship, receive and store energetic materials.

Interested firms are invited to indicate their interest electronically by emailing Mr. Rayfield Carter at rayfield.carter@us.army.mil no later than (13 OCTOBER 2010) 30 calendar days after the posting of this announcement.

Disclaimer: This is a market survey for planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a Request for Proposal or as an obligation on the part of the government. The government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this market survey or otherwise pay for information solicited. Participation in this effort is strictly voluntary. The government will utilize the information provided only to develop the acquisition strategy for the future requirements. All information submitted will be held in a confidential status.
